_comment: Experience and levels (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, Progression). XP is earned at the end of a match - mostly from a normal match against other people, and the same way from practice or solo up to a daily cap - and the level it adds up to is shown with your name. Every level climbed pays a key, and keys unlock builders and cosmetics (keys, below). Every number here is a first guess, to tune once there are players.

levels._comment: XP to climb from level L to L + 1 is first + step x (L - 1): 300 to reach level 2, then 400, 500 and so on. A straight line, so every level asks a little more than the last without ever running away, and there is no top. Level 10 is 6,300 XP in all - about twenty normal matches, at the 300 or so an average one earns.

match._comment: A normal match, played to the end of YOUR match: eliminated, or the last one standing. Leaving early earns nothing. Everyone who plays it out earns played; then every wave survived, the placement (1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th), and reaching the Final Showdown. Waves are worth the most in all: a match won in the showdown is 50 + 25 x 10 + 150 + 50 = 500; out on wave 6 in fourth is 50 + 5 x 10 + 20 = 120.

casual._comment: Practice and solo earn the way a normal match does, line by line - played, waves survived, and in practice the placement and the Final Showdown (solo has no one to place against) - up to dailyCap XP a day between them. A match that crosses the cap earns what was left of it, and the breakdown says so; after that, nothing until tomorrow. Boosts are added on top of what the cap allows. A day is the device's own calendar day.

adBoost._comment: The opt-in ad. Before any game that can earn XP, a player with fewer than offerBelow boosted waves left is asked whether to watch one. Yes plays it and adds waves boosted waves, to maxWaves at most - so 10 left and another ad makes 35; No goes straight to the game. As many a day as anyone likes. bonus is the boost: 0.5 is +50%. A boosted wave is a wave of a match that earns XP: the match's XP is boosted for the share of its waves the boost covers, and those waves are used up. A match that earns nothing uses none. A Supporter's boost is always on, with no ad and no waves used.

supporter._comment: A Supporter earns bonus more on every match, for good, and has the ad's boost always on besides (adBoost). Boosts add rather than multiply: the two together are 1 + 0.5 + 0.75 = 2.25 times, +125%. A Founder (store.json, founders) has everything a Supporter has.

keys._comment: What levels pay, and what builders and cosmetics are unlocked with - nothing in the game is bought with money but Supporter. perLevel keys for every level climbed, none for level 1, so level L has paid (L - 1) x perLevel. Every builder but the starter costs builder keys: three of them at 3 keys is all four builders by level 10. A cosmetic's cost is in cosmetics.json; titles and the badges that mean something are earned by what they mean instead.
